uris.description: Only check these game URIs. Without it, the job checks every game.

after.description: Resume a full scan after this game URI, such as the after of a stopped run. Cannot be combined with uris.

dryRun.description: Compare only, and report what would be rewritten.

maxGames.description: Stop after checking this many games, for a trial run.

status.description: The existing job's status, when alreadyQueued is true.

alreadyQueued.description: True when a search reindex was already pending or running; jobId is that job, and nothing new was queued.

main.description: Queue a job that finds games whose search document is missing, gutted or stale, and rewrites those documents from the index. Admins only. One search reindex runs at a time, and none while a catalogue reindex is pending or running. Run with dryRun first.
